description: Internal validation pass over the raw dict parsed from config/parameters.toml, applied before constructing AcquisitionConfig / EnrichmentParams / AnalysisParams. Factored out of load_parameters as its own function so each invalid-input case in the module spec's testing list can be exercised directly against a plain dict fixture, without needing a full TOML file per case.
docstring:
Validate the raw parsed contents of parameters.toml against every invariant required by config's three parameter dataclasses.

Args:
    raw: The dict produced by tomllib.load on config/parameters.toml (or an equivalent in-memory fixture dict in tests).

Returns:
    None if every check passes.

Raises:
    ParameterError: On the first violated invariant, with a message naming the offending section/key and the actual value. Checks run in a fixed order (missing section -> missing key -> out-of-range value -> weights-sum -> ordering) so error messages are deterministic across otherwise-invalid fixtures with multiple problems.
preconditions: raw is the direct output of a TOML parse (nested dicts/lists/primitives only, no dataclasses yet)
postconditions: If validate_parameters returns without raising, load_parameters may construct all three dataclasses from raw without any further defensive checks

edge_cases.expected_behavior: ParameterError naming the bucket and the unordered triple
